video.title: The Ornn Problem
video.description:
In this video, I discuss the layers of problems with Ornn.
There's obviously so much more I could have talked about in this video. I could have talked about how awful it is when your teammates rush the MasterWork upgrade items. I could talk about how awful the fact that ALL of his abilities scale from different things (q scales with AD, W with HP, E with bonus armor and MR, R with ap and a really bad ratio too LUL).  But, the main focus of this video is simply on the idea that Ornn's kit is unbalanceable for the game. He has aspects of his kit that should never exist in League of Legends. 

After I finish a video, I always see small things that people might misinterpret. For example, with I compared Ornn E to Poppy E, I obviously understand that these abilities are totally different and Poppy E is actually a superior ability because it's faster and more versatile. What I'm trying to compare is the Max Reward for both abilities are pretty similar, you're trying to hit them next to terrain. I hope I didn't create misunderstandings.

video.title: (ENG) Evolve order on Kha Zix Jungle
video.description:
What to evolve as Kha Zix jungle in different scenarious 

Recently I have been asked so many times about my evolve order and why I evolve as I do, I have always said that the evolve order on kha zix is situational, but never really gone in depth on what situational really means. 

Thats why I made this video about the evolve order on Kha Zix Jungle 

First a walk through on What the different abilites does when they are evolved 

Then going on to what to evolve depending on what situation you are in 

And last but not least give you some specific champions and abilites that counters the different evolutions 

If you wan´t to know what my typical evolve order is, then it is Q at lvl 6, W at lvl 11 and E at lvl 16. 

Though this evolve order is not always the best and that´s why I made this video, to give you guys some what of an idea on what to evolve at what point or stage in the game. 

Mainly E and R are the evoulutions that can get countered. 

E evolve is getting countered by cc, such as Poppy´s W, Veigar´s E or Janna´s Q and R while R evolve is getting countered by champions who can reveal stealth, such as Lee sin with his Q and E or Twisted Fate with his R. 

If you are against some of theese champions you might want to evolve in a different way that you usually do :)

video.title: The Ornn Problem
video.description:
In this video, I discuss the layers of problems with Ornn.
There's obviously so much more I could have talked about in this video. I could have talked about how awful it is when your teammates rush the MasterWork upgrade items. I could talk about how awful the fact that ALL of his abilities scale from different things (q scales with AD, W with HP, E with bonus armor and MR, R with ap and a really bad ratio too LUL).  But, the main focus of this video is simply on the idea that Ornn's kit is unbalanceable for the game. He has aspects of his kit that should never exist in League of Legends. 

After I finish a video, I always see small things that people might misinterpret. For example, with I compared Ornn E to Poppy E, I obviously understand that these abilities are totally different and Poppy E is actually a superior ability because it's faster and more versatile. What I'm trying to compare is the Max Reward for both abilities are pretty similar, you're trying to hit them next to terrain. I hope I didn't create misunderstandings.

rip no audio...

Notes:
11:30 - After firing q I should have casted ult knowing that blitz silence stops Jhin from flashing

16:00 - I maybe could have saved ult here for when they tank tower and olaf doesn't have ult

18:25 - this engage should be free because our team's followup is very strong

18:50 - Mistake, I should always play around olaf flanking us but I got fixated on the tower and poking lissandra

21:11 - Salvaged the fight somehow

23:54 - The general game plan is to hold onto ult until after olaf ult is over. 2 for 3 outcome is good considering the huge gold disadvantage

27:10 - Playing to live here, if I die there's no hope of winning the fight

30:05 - Good fight for us because low value Jhin and Olaf ult, but we lose the fight anyways. Important thing to note here is that even though my team does something boosted, I shouldn't do a boosted play as well (I lived)

32:50 - I get outplayed by poppy tp, I should have seen her on the map and known to just run towards my team

34:50 - Lots of dancing, we do not fight if they can flank us because then our backline just dies and we lose. Securing the flank here is the #1 priority before looking to engage

35:20 - Baron over elder, plus it didn't even spawn and they went to it

35:40 - If I die we lose, prioritize my life over anything else. 

36:10 - lmao

video.title: Poppy - Keeper of the Hammer - Champion Rework Reveal
video.description:
Passive: Iron Ambassador
Purchase RP here (Amazon Affiliate - NA): https://amzn.to/2qZ3Bmv

Every several seconds, Poppy throws her buckler as her basic attack, gaining range and bonus magic damage. Once thrown, Poppy can pick up her buckler to gain a shield, but if an enemy walks over her buckler, they’ll temporarily destroy it. If Iron Ambassador kills the target, the buckler returns to Poppy instead of falling to the ground.



Q: Hammer Shock

Poppy smashes the ground, dealing damage and slowing enemies in a small area. After a moment, the crushed ground erupts, dealing the same amount of damage again.



W: Steadfast Presence

Passive: Poppy gains bonus Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus is doubled if Poppy is below 40% health.

Active: Poppy gains Movement Speed. While Steadfast Presence is active, she creates a magic barrier around her, stopping enemy dashes and dealing magic damage to enemies.



E: Heroic Charge

Poppy tackles an enemy, dealing physical damage and carrying them forward. Poppy deals additional physical damage and stuns the enemy if they collide with terrain.



R: Keeper’s Verdict

Poppy charges up her hammer for a mighty blow, slowing herself as she winds up. With the second cast, Poppy unleashes a massive hammer smash, creating a fissure that deals damage and knocks back all enemy champions in a tiny area an enormous distance towards their base. The fissure length and knockback increase with channel duration.
